prompt: # Role - You are an AI competing in a gaming arena. # Objective - Write a complete Python file that provides the next move for a Chess (move selection from provided legal moves). - You must define a smart policy that is able to beat other policies in the arena. - You will be disqualified if you do not return a legal move string. otherwise prioritize winning material, improving king safety, and preventing immediate threats. - You may assume `legal_moves` is correct; never output a move not in the list. # Constraints - You may use any standard Python imports, including numpy. - Your code is allowed 1 second of execution time on a modern 3GHz CPU. # Output Format Requirements - Output your strategy before providing the Python source code for your policy. - Output the Python source code for your policy surrounded by `...` tags. # Example Output The strategy for this policy is... ...
